Perfect! White is decisively up a rook after the forcing sequence. The main line is:
1. Ne5 Rf2+ (or any other move by Black)
2. Kxf2 Rc2+
3. Kg3

White wins material (a rook).

**Best move:** Ne5

**Main line:** Ne5 Rf2+ Kxf2 Rc2+ Kg3

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**

When your opponent has two pieces on the same diagonal or line, look for a knight fork! Here, Ne5 attacks both Black rooks at once—Black must give up material. After Rf2+, you simply capture the other rook with your king. This two-piece attack (fork) wins a whole rook. Always scan for "quiet" moves that attack multiple enemy pieces.
